title.en: What one move ensures, and covering of moves
title.zh: 一步所确保者与动作的覆盖

statement.en: The moves of one process at a configuration cover another's exactly where every goal one move of the other ensures, one move of the first ensures; covering is a preorder carried along revisions, and a failed cover names a lost goal under double-negation elimination, taken as a hypothesis.
statement.zh: 一个过程在某构形的动作覆盖另一个的，恰当后者一步所确保的每个目标前者一步也确保；覆盖是预序，沿逐次修订传递；以双重否定消去为假设时，失败的覆盖指出一个失去的目标。

laws.en: One move completes a goal from a configuration exactly where it is enabled there and every outcome meets the goal; a goal is ensured where some move does so. The moves of Q at t cover those of P at s where each enabled move of P is matched by an enabled move of Q whose outcomes are among its own, and they cover exactly where every goal P ensures from s, Q ensures from t.
laws.zh: 一步从某构形完成一个目标，恰当它在那里可行且每个结果都满足该目标；有某一步如此时，目标被确保。Q 在 t 的动作覆盖 P 在 s 的动作，指 P 的每个可行动作都有 Q 的一个可行动作相配，其结果都在前者结果之中；恰当 P 从 s 确保的每个目标 Q 从 t 也确保时覆盖。

laws.en: Covering is reflexive and transitive; revisions of a process, each covering the last, cover the first at every stage, the types of moves free to change at each revision.
laws.zh: 覆盖自反且传递；一个过程的逐次修订，每次覆盖上一次，则在每个阶段都覆盖第一次，动作的类型可在每次修订时改变。

laws.en: A cover fails exactly where not every goal is carried; under double-negation elimination, taken as a hypothesis, a failed cover names a goal the covered process ensures and the other does not.
laws.zh: 覆盖恰在并非每个目标都被带过之处失败；以双重否定消去为假设时，失败的覆盖指出一个被覆盖过程确保而另一个不确保的目标。

laws.en: Laws of every process: a move completing a goal completes every weaker one; the goal nothing meets is never ensured; the goal everything meets is ensured exactly where some move is enabled; where P has an enabled move at s and Q at t covers it, some goal is ensured by both; and it is never so that every goal is ensured by Q and not by P.
laws.zh: 每个过程的规律：完成一个目标的一步完成每个更弱的目标；无物满足的目标从不被确保；万物满足的目标恰在某一步可行处被确保；P 在 s 有可行步且 Q 在 t 覆盖它时，有某目标两者都确保；决不会每个目标都被 Q 确保而不被 P 确保。

laws.en: A goal read through a summary of the outcomes is ensured exactly where its pullback to the configurations is; a common response for a belief completes from every configuration where the belief holds.
laws.zh: 经结果之摘要读出的目标，恰在其拉回到构形的目标被确保时被确保；对一个信念的共同回应，从该信念成立的每个构形完成。

laws.en: Witnesses on two configurations: the free process can reach more outcomes than the constant law and does not cover it; the law covers the free process and loses a possibility; the setting process covers the law, ensures a new goal and opens what was closed; goals it ensures separately are not ensured jointly; the halted process does not ensure false, which every outcome of its move meets; a summary can hide a loss.
laws.zh: 两个构形上的见证：自由过程比常值律能达到更多结果，却不覆盖它；常值律覆盖自由过程而失去一种可能；设定过程覆盖常值律，确保新目标并打开原已关闭者；它分别确保的目标并不共同被确保；停止的过程不确保“假”，虽其动作的每个结果都满足之；摘要可隐去一项损失。

hypotheses.en: Processes on any type of configurations with any types of moves; goals are predicates of configurations, and nothing else is assumed of the processes.
hypotheses.zh: 任意构形类型、任意动作类型上的过程；目标是构形的谓词，此外对过程不作任何假定。

hypotheses.en: No premise: every MoveOutcomeProcesses declaration has an empty axiom report; double-negation elimination enters only as the hypothesis of lost_goal_of_not_covers_of_dne.
hypotheses.zh: 无前提：MoveOutcomeProcesses 的每个声明公理报告皆空；双重否定消去只作为 lost_goal_of_not_covers_of_dne 的假设出现。

does_not_show.en: That double-negation elimination is needed to name a lost goal: the Lean shows that it suffices.
does_not_show.zh: 指出失去的目标需要双重否定消去：Lean 只表明它足够。

does_not_show.en: That covering, or more possible outcomes, is a gain: covering can remove a possibility, and more outcomes need not cover.
does_not_show.zh: 覆盖或更多可能结果是一种增益：覆盖可去掉一种可能，更多结果也未必覆盖。

detail.en: The free process reaches every outcome the constant law reaches and more, yet does not cover it (free_wider_not_covering).
detail.zh: 自由过程达到常值律所达到的每个结果且更多，却不覆盖它（free_wider_not_covering）。

detail.en: Read through the summary sending everything to false, a move of the free process meets the goal false; read whole, none ensures it (summary_hides_loss).
detail.zh: 经把一切送到假的摘要读出，自由过程的一步满足目标“假”；整体读出，没有一步确保它（summary_hides_loss）。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked (Lean 4.29.1): Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses by the consolidated core checker (receipt 20261025T212948.819150Z), every declaration with an empty axiom report; current bytes bound. Read against the Lean for this record; not independently reviewed.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 实查：Becoming.MoveOutcomeProcesses 经合并核心检查器（回执 20261025T212948.819150Z），每个声明公理报告皆空；当前字节皆绑定。为本记录对照 Lean 审读；未经独立审查。

next_delta.en: Carry covering past one move: state when the moves of one process cover another's along every finite course, so that what a revision keeps is read off the goals its courses still ensure.
next_delta.zh: 把覆盖推到一步之外：陈述一个过程的动作何时沿每个有限之程覆盖另一个的，使修订所保留者由其诸程仍确保的目标读出。

correspondence.en: Covering, each move matched by one whose outcomes are among its own, is the one-step form of alternating simulation (Alur, Henzinger, Kupferman and Vardi 1998), which keeps what one side can force. Reading covering revisions as a practice keeping what it could ensure is the AI's reading.
correspondence.zh: 覆盖（每一步都有一步相配，其结果在前者结果之中）是交替模拟的一步形式（Alur、Henzinger、Kupferman 与 Vardi 1998），它保持一方所能迫使者。把覆盖的修订读作保持其所能确保者的实践，是 AI 的读法。

detail.en: What a summary keeps of feasibility; here a summary of outcomes can hide a loss.
detail.zh: 摘要保留可行性的什么；此处结果之摘要可隐去一项损失。

detail.en: A total keeps a transfer exactly and hides the loss of a coordinate.
detail.zh: 总量精确保持转移而隐去一个坐标的损失。

detail.en: Plans branching on observations; a common response for a belief is their one-step case.
detail.zh: 依观察分支的计划；对信念的共同回应是其一步情形。

history.zh: 2026年10月27日：新增（DF2），一步所确保者、恰在每个一步目标都被带过处的动作覆盖、其沿修订的预序，以及两个构形上的见证，皆在核心；出自 DEFECTS-FOUND（分诊第 140 与 284 行）；研究第 426 节。
